definitions.explanation: Describes things made or arranged in the traditional Japanese manner, as opposed to Western style. Commonly used for toilets, rooms, clothing, and architecture.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和式|わしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This ryokan has many Japanese-style rooms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和式|わしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧で、⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother's house is a Japanese-style building with many tatami rooms.

notes:
Refers to things designed or arranged according to traditional Japanese conventions, in contrast to ⟦{洋式|ようしき}→洋式：19791_youshiki⟧ (Western style). One of the most common everyday uses is the distinction between {和式|わしき}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ (squat toilet) and ⟦{洋式|ようしき}→洋式：19791_youshiki⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ (seated toilet).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和式|わしき}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧: Japanese-style (squat) toilet
- {和式|わしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: Japanese-style room (with tatami)
- {和式|わしき}⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧: Japanese-style architecture
- {和式|わしき}⟦{庭園|ていえん}→庭園：12452_teien⟧: Japanese-style garden

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洋式|ようしき}→洋式：19791_youshiki⟧: Western style — the direct contrast; ⟦{洋式|ようしき}→洋式：19791_youshiki⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧, ⟦{洋式|ようしき}→洋式：19791_youshiki⟧⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧
- ⟦{和風|わふう}→和風：12034_wafuu⟧: Japanese-style — broader and more casual; often used for food (⟦{和風|わふう}→和風：12034_wafuu⟧⟦パスタ→パスタ：06768_pasuta⟧) and design
- ⟦{日本式|にほんしき}→日本式：28462_nihonshiki⟧: Japanese method/way — emphasizes the method or system rather than the aesthetic style
